legacyPatterns.message: Surface still renders one-off inline chart functions instead of adopting dashboard-kit chart primitives.
Surface still renders one-off depth chart functions instead of adopting LiquidityDepthChart or the static chart-surface contract.
Production-facing surfaces should not present real data as prototype preview copy.
Visual selection bridge must be development-only and blocked from production hosts.
Production dashboards should not embed another full dashboard shell; decompose promoted prototypes into shell, page content, components, and route config.
Production navigation should not link directly to prototype gallery pages.
Active prototype HTML routes should be dev review or compatibility routes, not primary production operator paths.
Surface uses local chart-card styling; confirm it is backed by dashboard-kit chart surface classes.

experienceTiers.label: Raw legacy report
experienceTiers.completionMeaning: Legacy/debug evidence only; not production complete.

experienceTiers.label: Shared component dashboard
experienceTiers.completionMeaning: Production-reviewable when shared components, states, and proof routes are present.

experienceTierBands.label: Planned or governance-only
experienceTierBands.meaning: Project is registered for governance/readiness but has no audited operator surface yet.

experienceTierBands.label: Raw legacy surface
experienceTierBands.meaning: Dashboard exists as a raw report, debug table, prototype, or ungoverned screen.

experienceTierBands.label: Adapter-aligned shell
experienceTierBands.meaning: Canonical CSS/static adapter is synced, but no surface-level component inventory is enforceable.

experienceTierBands.label: Inventoried one-shell report
experienceTierBands.meaning: One-shell route and surfaces are inventoried, but the main operator path still reads as a report.

experienceTierBands.label: Hybrid shared-component dashboard
experienceTierBands.meaning: Primary surface uses shared-kit contracts through a static or hybrid implementation, but is not fully package-native.

experienceTierBands.label: Package-native shared-component dashboard
experienceTierBands.meaning: Primary surface imports shared components directly and covers required dashboard states, but is not yet a product-grade cockpit.

experienceTierBands.label: Cockpit candidate with review gaps
experienceTierBands.meaning: Dashboard targets product-grade cockpit behavior but still has Tier 3 visual, shell, chart, proof, or interaction warnings.

experienceTierBands.label: Current static/hybrid product cockpit
experienceTierBands.meaning: Audited product-grade cockpit is current, but delivery still depends on static or hybrid adapter infrastructure.

experienceTierBands.label: Package-native product cockpit
experienceTierBands.meaning: Highest maturity: audited Tier 3 cockpit implemented directly with shared package components and complete proof/validation.

projects.name: Kashi VC
projects.tierMigrationNote: Kashi VC Live Command is the current Tier 3 reference surface for live market cockpit behavior, but the highest maturity target remains T3C package-native delivery.

projects.name: Media Engine
projects.tierMigrationNote: Media Engine production renderer satisfies the Tier 3 cockpit standard through a static/hybrid bridge with shared-kit shell markers, sidebar rail, compact command header, overflow protection, state checklist, entity cards, drilldown drawer, AI review panel, chart telemetry, proof/state surfaces, and raw tables retained as secondary evidence. The next maturity target is T3C package-native delivery.

projects.name: Media Business OS
projects.tierMigrationNote: Media Business OS has adapter-level alignment but still needs a product-grade operating cockpit migration.

projects.name: Business Mapper
projects.tierMigrationNote: Business Mapper should move from static adapter usage to shared component dashboard quality before being considered complete.

projects.name: Meal Assistant
projects.tierMigrationNote: Meal Assistant is currently server-rendered/static dashboard UI and should move to package-native shared component dashboard quality before being considered complete.

projects.name: Hermes OS
projects.tierMigrationNote: Hermes OS is planned in this registry and must move through shell, shared components, and product-grade cockpit adoption.

projects.name: TLC Capital Group OS
projects.tierMigrationNote: TLC Capital Group OS is planned in this registry and must move through shell, shared components, and product-grade cockpit adoption.
